recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the current-spec withdrawal by removing the only current guide reference that still classified OccupationalData as a resource; inactive source remnants and historical release notes do not require source changes for this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-16930 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and requested withdrawal of OccupationalData because occupational data should be represented through questionnaires, logical models, mappings, and principally Observations rather than a dedicated core resource.
initial_application: The historical implementation commit efef182022eba3d6868acbe3fda5360783848135 removed OccupationalData from active fhir.ini resource/workgroup/status mappings and removed Resource Guide prose, leaving OccupationalData out of the current build as a resource. A Resource Guide table row linking to occupationaldata.html remained.
additional_context: FHIR-14868 reached the same withdrawal decision and says to see FHIR-16930. Zulip and PHWG Confluence evidence from 2018 confirm the direction shifted from a core resource to Observation-based profiles and an ODH implementation guide. Historical release notes still mention OccupationalData in R4 draft/ballot builds and were left unchanged as historical record.
reconciliation: Deleted the stale row from source/resourceguide.html. Resource Guide is part of the current page hierarchy and linked from current documentation pages, while source/occupationaldata.html is absent and OccupationalData is not active in source/fhir.ini.
source_changes: source/resourceguide.html: removed the OccupationalData Resource Classification table row linking to absent occupationaldata.html.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published/Persuasive ODH issue with the same withdrawal decision; its resolution says to see FHIR-16930.

evidence_items.summary: Lloyd McKenzie and Rob Hausam explained in September 2018 that OccupationalData was retired and replaced by Observation profiles and an ODH IG.

evidence_items.summary: PHWG minutes record that ballot comments questioned a new OccupationalData resource, implementers were leaning toward Observation profiles, and the project team planned an Observation-based ballot.
evidence_items.learned: Meeting evidence aligns with the Jira resolution and constrains the reconciliation to removing current core-resource guidance.
